nodes.description: Contract owner address; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor and updated on ownership acceptance.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership before acceptOwnership.
Mapping tracking last airdrop block per caller for cooldown enforcement.
Mapping of addresses marked as active participants; gates airdrop eligibility and reward logic.
Circular buffer mapping index to address used as reward recipient pool.
Conversion rate used in tokenSale to compute minted tokens from msg.value.
Maximum total supply permitted during the token sale.

Minimum airdrop amount returned once soft cap is reached.
Base airdrop amount used in the linear decay formula.
Cooldown (in blocks) between airdrops for the same caller.
Minimum reward amount returned once soft cap is reached.
Base reward amount used in the linear decay formula.
Size cap for the prizeLog circular buffer.
Minimum transfer size required to register the sender into the reward pool.
Write cursor into the prizeLog circular buffer.
Flag indicating prizeLog buffer has wrapped and rewardPool modulus should be used.
Token symbol string.
Token name string.
Token decimals value.
Internal total supply counter used across minting and cap checks.
Core ledger mapping of address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Owner-only function staging a new owner address for later acceptance.
Completes ownership transfer when called by the pending new owner.
Internal function increasing balances and _totalSupply and emitting Transfer.
View function deriving a pseudo-random reward recipient from block.timestamp and state.
Internal function managing the prizeLog circular buffer and pointer/wrapped state.
View function computing airdrop amount based on _totalSupply versus softCapVal.
View function computing reward amount based on _totalSupply versus softCapVal.

Returns _totalSupply minus balances at address(0).
Returns balance of a given token owner.
Transfers tokens between accounts and triggers reward minting logic.

Receive function accepting plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, access control and reward allocation.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
New owner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
onlyOwner guard compares msg.sender with owner before executing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
newOwner state is read and compared inside acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
getAirdrop reads msg.sender for cooldown, activity and minting to caller.
Target address parameter flows into activity updates and mint.
getAirdrop calls internal mint twice to credit target and caller.
getAirdrop writes the current block number into lastDrop for the caller.
getAirdrop sets activity flags for caller and target.
getAirdrop performs unguarded minting logic captured as an unsafe operation.
getAirdrop calls calcAirdrop to determine mint amount.
tokenSale reads msg.sender to update activity and mint purchased tokens.
tokenSale mints purchased tokens to the buyer.
tokenSale converts msg.value to tokens and mints within an unsafe operation.
Locally computed token amount is derived from msg.value and ethToToken inside tokenSale.
Local holding msg.value feeds the token amount computation.
ethToToken rate multiplies msg.value to derive minted tokens.
saleCutOff caps the total supply minted during the sale.
adminWithdrawal performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer.
Token contract parameter is the target of the external transfer call.
Amount parameter is passed into the external transfer call.
adminWithdrawal is gated by the onlyOwner modifier against msg.sender.
clearETH performs a native value transfer of the whole contract balance.
clearETH is restricted by onlyOwner to msg.sender equal to owner.
block.timestamp seeds the keccak hash used to pick the reward recipient.
rewardRand derives recipient randomness from miner-influenced timestamp.
_totalSupply is part of the randomness seed inside rewardRand.
transfer calls rewardRand to choose a reward recipient.
transfer calls rewardlistHandler to register eligible senders into prizeLog.
transfer mints reward tokens to the selected drop address.
transfer calls calcReward to size the reward mint.
Local drop address feeds the reward mint call inside transfer.
Recipient parameter is credited in the transfer balance accounting.
Token amount parameter drives balance subtraction and reward memo comparison.
transfer mutates the balances ledger using SafeMath sub and add.
transferFrom mutates balances and allowed using SafeMath operations.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
approve writes the spender allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall reads msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a user-supplied spender contract, opening a reentrant callback.
approveAndCall writes the spender allowance before the external callback.
receive accepts plain ETH that later becomes the balance swept by clearETH.
fallback reverts, routing ETH accounting toward the receive path used by clearETH.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and zero-address balances.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
calcReward compares total supply against softCapVal threshold.
calcAirdrop compares total supply against softCapVal threshold.
rewardPool bounds the modulo when the buffer is wrapped.
pointer is used as a divisor in rewardRand, risking modulo-by-zero.
wrapped flag selects which modulus rewardRand applies.
rewardlistHandler increments pointer and resets it against rewardPool.
rewardlistHandler writes the sender into the prizeLog buffer.
rewardMemo threshold decides whether a sender qualifies for pool registration.

normalization_plan.reason: The new owner parameter exists only to feed transferOwnership and can be normalized into that core function.
The ERC20 token parameter is only meaningful as the external call target of adminWithdrawal and folds into it.
The withdrawal amount parameter only feeds the external transfer call in adminWithdrawal and folds into it.
The airdrop target parameter is only consumed by getAirdrop minting logic and folds into that core function.
The recipient parameter is only used within transfer balance accounting and folds into that core function.
The token amount parameter is only used within transfer and reward eligibility checks, folding into that core function.
The computed token amount is a transient local of tokenSale and folds into that core function.
The msg.value local is a transient value inside tokenSale and folds into that core function.
The keccak seed local exists only inside rewardRand and folds into that core function.
The selected reward recipient local exists only inside transfer and folds into that core function.
